Starting your PhD
Starting your PhD
Here you’ll find the key information you need at the beginning: enrolment and administrative requirements, supervision agreements, curriculum details, course registration, and important contacts. This section helps you get organised early on and move into your research with clarity and structure.
How to join the VDSEE
To join our DocSchool you have to meet the following criteria:
You are admitted to the University of Vienna to a Doctoral Program
You have to have a project with one of our supervisors
You have to sign the Code of Good Practice for Doctoral Schools
Need a project?
If you are still looking for a project in ecology or evolution, have a look at the research conducted by our supervisors and contact them directly.
Check out our Research Section
Admission to a doctoral programme
If you are currently in the process of being admitted to a doctoral programme at the University of Vienna you find all needed information and contact information at the Center for Doctoral Studies!
Center for Doctoral Studies
Code of Good Practice
You want to join the Vienna Doctoral School of Ecology and Evolution?
You are admitted to a doctoral program and have a project with one of our supervisors?
If so, please read our Code of Good Practice carefully to learn about your responsibilities as a PhD student, and then sign it.
Find our Code of Good Practice here
After joining the VDSEE
After signing the Code of Good Practice and joining VDSEE, the next steps are:
Attend the VDSEE Welcome Session to receive key information for your first months and ask initial questions
Prepare your PhD project presentation, which is a mandatory milestone within the first year of your PhD
Check out the VDSEE administration tool
